Every member serves one concern: the shared base for portfolio report rules. That covers rule identity (getKey), localization (getLanguageCode), the abstract evaluation methods (evaluate, getConfiguration, getName, getSettings) and a shared helper, groupCurrentHoldingsByAttribute. The incoming graph shows many rule subclasses extend Rule, so the grouping helper lives in this one base class rather than being copied into each rule.
